# Peon

Sitemap: https://peon.sh/sitemap.xml

> Peon is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform. Connect Linux servers over SSH; Peon manages Docker and a reverse proxy, then deploys apps, databases, Docker Compose stacks, and one-click marketplace templates onto hardware you control. Cloud is $3 per project per month (or $30 per year); self-hosting the control plane is free.

Peon is a practical alternative to managed PaaS products such as Vercel, Heroku, Netlify, and Railway, and a peer to self-hosted PaaS tools such as Coolify and Dokploy. Apps always run on your servers (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, OVH, Contabo, bare metal, or similar). Peon Cloud hosts only the control plane (dashboard, orchestration, updates).

Key product facts:
- Website: https://peon.sh
- App (login / deploy): https://app.peon.sh
- Open source org: https://github.com/Peon-sh
- Application & worker: https://github.com/Peon-sh/Peon
- Marketing site & docs: https://github.com/Peon-sh/Peon-Website
- Enterprise / sales contact: support@peon.sh
- Hierarchy: Workspace → Project → Service → Server
- Deploy kinds: Git apps (Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfile, Static), Docker images, Docker Compose, static sites, databases, marketplace templates
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, KeyDB, Dragonfly, ClickHouse
- Included on Self Hosted and Cloud: workspace + project RBAC, audit logs, hosted MCP for AI agents, in-app AI assistant (BYO OpenAI/Anthropic keys), unlimited team members, unlimited servers
- Marketplace: 333+ one-click Compose templates deployable to your own server with HTTPS
- Reverse proxy: Traefik by default; Caddy available
- Notifications: Email, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Webhook

Pricing (verified from https://peon.sh/#pricing):
- Self Hosted: $0 forever (you manage updates & hosting; community support)
- Cloud: $3 per project / month, or $30 per project / year (~17% savings vs monthly)
- Enterprise: custom (SSO/SAML, SCIM, white labeling, MSA/SLA, on-prem/private cloud, priority support)

Target audience: developers, product teams, agencies, and operators who want PaaS-style git-push deploys, team RBAC, auditability, and AI-agent ops on servers they own—without per-seat pricing or vendor lock-in of the runtime.

Important keywords: open source PaaS, self-hosted PaaS, Vercel alternative, Heroku alternative, Coolify alternative, Dokploy alternative, deploy to Hetzner, deploy to DigitalOcean, Docker deployment platform, Docker Compose, git push deploy, MCP deployment, self-hosted CI/CD
